Deal.title: Deal
Deal.description: A coupon or promo-code deal offer for a merchant

merchantName.description: Name of the store or merchant

merchantLogo.description: URL of the merchant logo image

couponCode.description: Coupon code to copy, or empty if no code needed

startDate.description: ISO date string for offer start

expirationDate.description: ISO date string for expiration, or empty

featured.description: Whether this deal is featured prominently on homepage

published.description: Whether this deal is active and published

clicks.description: Total click count for this deal

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO format

ClickLog.title: ClickLog
ClickLog.description: Individual click timestamp log for analytics

SupportComment.title: SupportComment
SupportComment.description: Anonymous user feedback, community question, or deal inquiry

name.description: Author display moniker (defaults to Anonymous Scout)

dealId.description: Optional deal ID this comment refers to

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the comment was submitted

/deals/{dealId}.description: Collection of coupon and promo deals

/deals/{dealId}/clicks/{clickId}.description: Subcollection of click analytics events for a deal

/support_comments/{commentId}.description: Public community support comments with admin moderation
